name: Desktop Application Security
purpose: Enforce IPC validation, native protocol safety, auto-update verification, and desktop sandbox isolation.
inputs: Desktop process model, IPC/protocol/deep-link surface, and threat model
Renderer, main-process, updater, sandbox, entitlement, and keychain behavior
Target operating systems, update-signing policy, abuse cases, and release gates
outputs: IPC, protocol, and update trust-boundary map with validation contracts
Fail-secure sandbox, update-signature, and secret-storage remediation
Traversal, malformed-message, tampered-update, and sandbox abuse evidence
stop_conditions: No unvalidated privileged IPC, unsafe protocol handler, or unsigned update path remains
Abuse tests reject malformed input, traversal, and tampered artifacts
Token budget exhausted or required platform-signing authority is unavailable
